summary: Iter 2 retest: ObjectId serialization bug fixed on POST /api/bots, duplicate_bot, and POST /api/contacts. Full bot->flow->publish->test chain now works. Publish correctly rejects invalid flow (0/2 start nodes) with 400. Frontend E2E (bot creation -> FlowEditor navigation -> palette visible -> Save toast -> Test panel -> WhatsApp pairing) all pass.

Tenant admin login (admin+iter2@iter2.com / iter2@123) 200
POST /api/bots 200 clean JSON with id + main_flow_id (ObjectId bug fixed)
GET /api/bots lists created bot
POST /api/bots/{id}/duplicate 200 returns new bot with (Cópia) suffix and new flow_id
PATCH /api/bots/{id} status 200 (rascunho -> pausado)
DELETE /api/bots/{id} 200
GET /api/flows/{flow_id} returns starter flow with 1 start node

Frontend: FlowEditor shows node-palette, palette-text, palette-menu, palette-end (all count=1)

failed.issue: POST /api/flows/{id}/test outputs return empty text content field even though node data.message='Bem-vindo!' was saved. Engine seems to read a different field key. Menu options render correctly, but text node 'content' is empty string.
failed.evidence: Test start response: outputs=[{type:'text',content:''},{type:'menu',content:'',options:['Um','Dois']}] despite PUT saving data.message='Bem-vindo!' and menu prompt='Escolha:'

failed.issue: After menu, posting message='1' returns outputs=[] with status='ativa' instead of traversing option-1 branch to End node and setting status='finalizada'. Gibberish input also returns empty outputs (no fallback text or 'invalid message').
failed.evidence: Second POST /test with session_id and message='1' -> {outputs:[], status:'ativa'}

failed.issue: PUT /api/flows/{id} accepts flows with 0 or 2 start nodes (returns 200). Review request expected 400 on save. Validation is only enforced on publish, not on save.
failed.evidence: PUT with 0 start nodes -> 200; PUT with 2 start nodes -> 200; publish then correctly rejects with 400.

failed.issue: POST /api/admin/tenants requires admin_name field (422 if missing). Not documented in test_credentials.md example.

action_items: Fix flow test engine to emit text node message content in outputs (likely wrong field lookup: node.data.message vs node.data.text/label).
Fix flow test engine menu traversal: after user posts option value, should walk the outgoing edge (sourceHandle match) and emit next node's output; also finalize session on End node.
Add fallback/invalid-input handling when user posts non-matching value after a menu.
Optional: enforce start-node count validation on PUT /flows/{id} save (or at least warn). Currently only publish enforces.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to include the admin_name field in the tenant creation example.

success_rate.backend: ~85% (bot CRUD, contacts, flow save/publish/versions all pass; flow execution engine has content+traversal issues)
